+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

codex
The dense data now remains resident on the GPU: one all-pairs kernel computes delays, another computes 16-sample form factors, each timestep uses a block-level reduction per receiver, and cross-correlation is parallelized across both triangles and lags. Validation-only matrices are copied back after timed work, so normal benchmark timing excludes unnecessary PCIe transfers.

 constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;

+// ============================================================================
+// CUDA Infrastructure

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

 constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {

+    }
+    return pointer;

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}

 constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}

+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess)                                     \

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};

+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};

+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}

+    val_t x, y, z;

+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for

+struct DeviceTriangle {

+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};

+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;

+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}

+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(triangles[i].center, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t count = n * n;
+    for (size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < count;
+         pair += static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x) {
+        const size_t i = pair / n;
+        const size_t j = pair - i * n;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
 
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}
