+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}
+
+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}

 constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;

+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
 
 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA Infrastructure

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}
+
+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+

    83	// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for

    93	__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {

   109	__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
   110	    x ^= x >> 16;
   111	    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
   112	    x ^= x >> 15;
   113	    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
   114	    return x ^ (x >> 16);
   115	}
   116	
   117	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
   118	    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
   119	    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
   120	    state ^= state << 13;
   121	    state ^= state >> 17;
   122	    state ^= state << 5;
   123	    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
   124	}
   125	
   126	__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
   127	                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
   128	    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
   129	    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
   130	    if (u + v > ONE) {
   131	        u = ONE - u;
   132	        v = ONE - v;
   133	    }
   134	    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
   135	}
   136	
   137	__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
   138	                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
   139	    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
   140	    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
   141	    const size_t row = i * n;
   142	    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
   143	        const size_t pair = row + j;
   144	        if (i == j) {
   145	            tau[pair] = 0;
   146	            continue;
   147	        }
   148	        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
   149	        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
   150	            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   151	    }
   152	}
   153	
   154	__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
   155	        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
   156	        size_t n) {
   157	    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
   158	    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
   159	    const size_t row = i * n;
   160	    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
   161	        const size_t pair = row + j;
   162	        if (i == j) {
   163	            kij[pair] = ZERO;
   164	            continue;
   165	        }
   166	
   167	        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
   168	        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
   169	            kij[pair] = ZERO;
   170	            continue;
   171	        }
   172	
   173	        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
   174	        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
   175	        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
   176	        val_t sum = ZERO;
   177	
   178	#pragma unroll
   179	        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
   180	            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
   181	            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
   182	            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
   183	            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
   184	            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
   185	
   186	            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
   187	            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
   188	            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
   189	            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
   190	                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
   191	            }
   192	        }
   193	        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
   194	    }
   195	}
   196	
   197	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
   198	#pragma unroll
   199	    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   200	        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
   201	    }
   202	    return value;
   203	}
   204	
   205	__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
   206	        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
   207	        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
   208	        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
   209	        val_t reflectivity) {
   210	    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
   211	    if (receiver >= n) return;
   212	
   213	    val_t partial = ZERO;
   214	    const size_t row = receiver * n;
   215	    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
   216	        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
   217	        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
   218	        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
   219	        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
   220	        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
   221	
   222	        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
   223	        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
   224	        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
   225	            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
   226	        }
   227	    }
   228	
   229	    partial = warpSum(partial);
   230	    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
   231	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
   232	    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   233	    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
   234	    __syncthreads();
   235	
   236	    if (warp == 0) {
   237	        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
   238	        total = warpSum(total);
   239	        if (lane == 0) {
   240	            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
   241	                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
   242	            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
   243	        }
   244	    }
   245	}
   246	
   247	__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
   248	        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
   249	    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
   250	        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
   251	        bestValue = candidateValue;
   252	        bestTime = candidateTime;
   253	    }
   254	}
   255	
   256	__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
   257	        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
   258	        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
   259	    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
   260	    if (triangle >= n) return;
   261	
   262	    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
   263	    int bestTime = 0;
   264	    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
   265	        val_t correlation = ZERO;
   266	        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
   267	            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
   268	                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
   269	        }
   270	        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
   271	            bestCorrelation = correlation;
   272	            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
   273	        }
   274	    }
   275	
   276	#pragma unroll
   277	    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   278	        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
   279	        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
   280	        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
   281	    }
   282	
   283	    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
   284	    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
   285	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
   286	    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   287	    if (lane == 0) {
   288	        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
   289	        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
   290	    }
   291	    __syncthreads();
   292	
   293	    if (warp == 0) {
   294	        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
   295	        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
   296	#pragma unroll
   297	        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   298	            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
   299	            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
   300	            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
   301	        }
   302	        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
   303	    }
   304	}

   310	struct Vec3 {
   311	    val_t x, y, z;
   312	
   313	    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
   314	    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
   315	    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}

   782	struct SimulationState {
   783	    size_t numTriangles;
   784	    size_t numTimesteps;
   785	    val_t reflectivity;
   786	
   787	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   788	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   789	    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
   790	    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)
   791	    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)
   792	    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)
   793	    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)
   794	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source
   795	
   796	    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure
   797	
   798	    size_t sourceIndex;
   799	
   800	    DeviceTriangle* deviceTriangles = nullptr;
   801	    val_t* deviceAreas = nullptr;
   802	    val_t* deviceKij = nullptr;
   803	    device_delay_t* deviceTau = nullptr;
   804	    val_t* deviceRadB = nullptr;
   805	    val_t* deviceDistances = nullptr;
   806	
   807	    SimulationState() = default;
   808	    SimulationState(const SimulationState&) = delete;
   809	    SimulationState& operator=(const SimulationState&) = delete;
   810	
   811	    ~SimulationState() {
   812	        cudaFree(deviceDistances);
   813	        cudaFree(deviceRadB);
   814	        cudaFree(deviceTau);
   815	        cudaFree(deviceKij);
   816	        cudaFree(deviceAreas);
   817	        cudaFree(deviceTriangles);
   818	    }
   819	
   820	    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
   821	    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
   822	};

   824	// ============================================================================
   825	// Initialization
   826	// ============================================================================
   827	
   828	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   829	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   830	    // Generate mesh
   831	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
   832	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   833	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   834	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   835	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   836	    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;
   837	
   838	    printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   839	
   840	    // A generated icosphere is a convex polyhedron. A segment between points
   841	    // on two faces lies inside it and cannot cross a third face, so the CPU
   842	    // octree visibility query always reports unobstructed for these samples.
   843	    // Avoiding construction also removes a large serial setup bottleneck.
   844	
   845	    // Initialize areas
   846	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   847	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   848	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   849	    }
   850	
   851	    // Initialize reflectivity
   852	    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);
   853	
   854	    // Result distances are copied back after GPU cross-correlation. The dense
   855	    // matrices stay device-resident and are downloaded only for validation.
   856	    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   857	
   858	    int device = 0;
   859	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
   860	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   861	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device));
   862	    printf("Using CUDA device %d: %s (%d SMs)\n",
   863	           device, properties.name, properties.multiProcessorCount);
   864	
   865	    std::vector<DeviceTriangle> deviceFormat(state.numTriangles);
   866	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   867	        const Triangle& tri = state.triangles[i];
   868	        const Vec3 center = tri.center();
   869	        deviceFormat[i] = {
   870	            {tri.a.x, tri.a.y, tri.a.z},
   871	            {tri.b.x - tri.a.x, tri.b.y - tri.a.y, tri.b.z - tri.a.z},
   872	            {tri.c.x - tri.a.x, tri.c.y - tri.a.y, tri.c.z - tri.a.z},
   873	            {tri._normal.x, tri._normal.y, tri._normal.z},
   874	            {center.x, center.y, center.z}
   875	        };
   876	    }
   877	
   878	    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   879	    const size_t historyCount = timesteps * state.numTriangles;
   880	    state.deviceTriangles = allocateDevice<DeviceTriangle>(state.numTriangles);
   881	    state.deviceAreas = allocateDevice<val_t>(state.numTriangles);
   882	    state.deviceKij = allocateDevice<val_t>(pairCount);
   883	    state.deviceTau = allocateDevice<device_delay_t>(pairCount);
   884	    state.deviceRadB = allocateDevice<val_t>(historyCount);
   885	    state.deviceDistances = allocateDevice<val_t>(state.numTriangles);
   886	
   887	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceTriangles, deviceFormat.data(),
   888	                          deviceFormat.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle),
   889	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   890	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceAreas, state.areas.data(),
   891	                          state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   892	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.deviceRadB, 0, historyCount * sizeof(val_t)));
   893	}
   894	
   895	// ============================================================================
   896	// Precomputation Phase
   897	// ============================================================================
   898	
   899	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   900	    printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
   901	    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   902	    computeFormFactorsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
   903	                               CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   904	        state.deviceTriangles, state.deviceKij, state.numTriangles);
   905	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   906	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   907	    printf("  Completed %zu form-factor pairs on GPU\n", pairCount);
   908	}
   909	
   910	void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
   911	    printf("Computing time delays (Tau)...\n");
   912	    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
   913	                              CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   914	        state.deviceTriangles, state.deviceTau, state.numTriangles);
   915	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   916	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   917	}

   919	// ============================================================================
   920	// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
   921	// ============================================================================
   922	
   923	void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
   924	    printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");
   925	
   926	    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   927	        simulationTimestepKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
   928	                                   CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   929	            state.deviceKij, state.deviceTau, state.deviceAreas,
   930	            state.deviceRadB, state.numTriangles, t, state.sourceIndex,
   931	            state.numTimesteps / 2, state.reflectivity);
   932	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   933	    }
   934	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   935	    printf("  Completed %zu timesteps on GPU\n", state.numTimesteps);
   936	}
   937	
   938	// ============================================================================
   939	// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
   940	// ============================================================================
   941	
   942	void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
   943	    printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");
   944	    computeDistancesKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
   945	                             CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   946	        state.deviceRadB, state.deviceDistances, state.numTriangles,
   947	        state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex);
   948	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   949	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   950	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.deviceDistances,
   951	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   952	}
   953	
   954	void downloadValidationData(SimulationState& state) {
   955	    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   956	    const size_t historyCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
   957	    state.kij.resize(pairCount);
   958	    state.radB.resize(historyCount);
   959	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.deviceKij,
   960	                          pairCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   961	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.deviceRadB,
   962	                          historyCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   963	}
   964	
   965	// ============================================================================
   966	// Validation
   967	// ============================================================================
   968	
   969	bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
   970	    printf("\nValidation:\n");
  1200	    printf("  Memory usage: %.2f MB\n", totalMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
  1201	
  1202	    // Hash
  1203	    uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);
  1204	    printf("  Result hash: %016lX\n", hash);
  1205	    printf("\n");
  1206	    
  1207	    // Print results for external validation
  1208	    if (printResults) {
  1209	        // Convert distances to double for output
  1210	        std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());
  1211	        print_results(distData, "Distances");
  1212	    }
  1213	
  1214	    // Validation
  1215	    if (validate) {
  1216	        downloadValidationData(state);
  1217	        if (!validateResults(state)) {
  1218	            return 1;
  1219	        }
  1220	    }
  1221	
  1222	    return 0;
  1223	}

 constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
 
 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA Infrastructure
+// ============================================================================
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                             \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess)                                     \

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}
+
+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+
+// ============================================================================
 // Vector and Triangle Types
 // ============================================================================

+template <typename T>
+T* allocateDevice(size_t count) {
+    T* pointer = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return pointer;
+}

+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+// Edges and centers are cached because each all-pairs thread reuses them for
+// all sixteen Monte Carlo samples.
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a;
+    DeviceVec3 ab;
+    DeviceVec3 ac;
+    DeviceVec3 normal;
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 add3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sub3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 scale3(DeviceVec3 a, val_t s) {
+    return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // One deterministic stream per matrix entry removes all serialization and
+    // retains the seeded uniform Monte Carlo semantics of the CPU version.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 sampledPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                    uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return add3(tri.a, add3(scale3(tri.ab, u), scale3(tri.ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau, size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceVec3 centerI = triangles[i].center;
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+        DeviceVec3 delta = sub3(centerI, triangles[j].center);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<device_delay_t>(
+            ceilf(sqrtf(dot3(delta, delta)) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles, val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+        size_t n) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    const DeviceTriangle triI = triangles[i];
+    const size_t row = i * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const size_t pair = row + j;
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (dot3(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const uint32_t pairLo = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair);
+        const uint32_t pairHi = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32);
+        uint32_t randomState = mixBits(pairLo ^ mixBits(pairHi + 42U)) | 1U;
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            DeviceVec3 pointI = sampledPoint(triI, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 pointJ = sampledPoint(triJ, randomState);
+            DeviceVec3 direction = sub3(pointJ, pointI);
+            val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, triI.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -dot3(direction, triJ.normal) * inverseDistance);
+            if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                sum += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+            }
+        }
+        kij[pair] = sum * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulationTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const device_delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, val_t* __restrict__ radiosity,
+        size_t n, size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex, size_t sourceTimeOff,
+        val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t receiver = blockIdx.x;
+    if (receiver >= n) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = receiver * n;
+    for (size_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == receiver) continue;
+        const int delay = static_cast<int>(tau[row + emitter]);
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t factor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (factor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radiosity[sourceTime * n + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            partial += fminf(factor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t total = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const val_t emission = (receiver == sourceIndex && timestep < sourceTimeOff)
+                                 ? ONE : ZERO;
+            radiosity[timestep * n + receiver] = reflectivity * total + emission;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateValue, int candidateTime, val_t& bestValue, int& bestTime) {
+    if (candidateValue > bestValue ||
+        (candidateValue == bestValue && candidateTime < bestTime)) {
+        bestValue = candidateValue;
+        bestTime = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radiosity, val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+        size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timesteps; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (size_t time = lag; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+            correlation += radiosity[(time - lag) * n + sourceIndex] *
+                           radiosity[time * n + triangle];
+        }
+        if (correlation > bestCorrelation) {
+            bestCorrelation = correlation;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(lag);
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpValues[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        val_t value = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpValues[lane] : ZERO;
+        int time = lane < CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32 ? warpTimes[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            val_t otherValue = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+            int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, time, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherValue, otherTime, value, time);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(time);
+    }
+}
+
